versions.changelog:
amazon-ads-open-cli 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides CLI access to Amazon Ads reporting and entity data (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display, DSP)
- Supports listing and inspecting campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, and audiences
- Enables async performance report generation via command line
- Detailed instructions for authentication using credentials file or environment variables
- Pretty-printed JSON output with pagination and filtering options for all major entities
- Full command reference included in documentation
